Select one or more physics areas

Physics-only by default, using source classifications and physics journal/category metadata. Unclassified records are available separately below the results. Classification is approximate; exact identifier lookups are never hidden.

Automatic mode recognizes initials and surnames such as A. Einstein. For a full name, choose Author name. Author searches require the surname and first given name or initial to match; All fields searches more broadly. Initials can identify several researchers: use the full first name when known. OpenAlex and Crossref cover all disciplines.

Searching more than one author? Choose Author name and join the names with +, for example A. Einstein + N. Rosen. All listed authors are required on the same paper.

ABOUT

A wider lens on physics literature

Physics Index combines public scholarly records, then merges duplicates by DOI, arXiv ID, and bibliographic details. It is a discovery aid, not an exhaustive index.

Direct mode
Crossref, OpenAlex, and INSPIRE from the browser.
Gateway mode
Adds arXiv, Semantic Scholar, INSPIRE, and optional NASA ADS.

Search text is sent only to the scholarly services shown in the source status.
Physics Index Coverage is source-dependent and not exhaustive. Data from participating scholarly APIs; arXiv use follows its API terms.
